Configures and operates the platform for everyone else: users and groups, sign-in and permissions, connections, scanners and system settings. An administrator is responsible for the product being available, secure and correctly set up, rather than for what the catalog contains. Also referred to as IT operations.

In the product the administrator works in Administration: configuring connections and scanners, managing users, groups and permissions, and setting governance policies and maintenance windows.
